name: repo-tor
title: Git Analytics Dashboard
description: Extract and visualize commit history from any git repository. Generate insights on progress, contributors, and code quality.
audience: Developers and managers who want to understand commit patterns, contributor activity, and code health across repositories.
useCases: Visualize commit activity across repositories with 6 dashboard tabs
Switch between Executive, Management, and Developer detail levels
Extract git history from local repos or via GitHub API
Embed individual charts via iframe with customizable colors

dataPrivacy.storage: Dashboard data loaded from static JSON files. No user data collected.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: GitHub API used for extraction scripts (optional).
